config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 2
statuses = [502]
backoff_base = 0.001
backoff_max = 0.002
deadline = 5.0

[providers.local]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "local-secret"

[[models]]
name = "native-llama"
provider = "local"
model = "llama3.1"
name: chat_retry_exhaustion
